citation_form.description: Dictionary headword: nouns and adjectives masculine singular, verbs infinitive. No plurals, conjugations, clitic forms or diminutives unless they are headwords.

keyboard_notes: Tilde and ñ by long-press (CC-SPELL-KEYBOARD). Capital letters fold. ¿ ¡ never appear in an answer. Eric 2026-11-05: the voice is from Spain, so es_scz (c/z against s) is an accent rule, not a true homophone rule.
